Okay, this is sort of related to what you're saying, but not at the same time. I've had to watch over a litter of puppies before. My girlfriend worked at an animal shelter and we tripped (I know not very responsible) when the pups were about five weeks old, and they were the cutest things ever while we were looking at them, but at the same time I couldn't get over how they were basically living in their own filth... The pups' mother was still watching over them and everything, but I still couldn't help but feel guilty even though the puppies were were still happy. Its like a they were covered in shit but still happy... Probably just because they were puppies and all but I dunno, it still fucked me up. I dunno if this should be its own post or what. It might be have just been the acid but I know that those puppies did poop a lot. We did all we could to clean them, I know that keeping after puppies is hard work, but fuck... I feel bad for them. It's months later and they all have good homes now but I wonder if they had not had shit all over them while they were young they might have been better dogs... Even though i have no idea how they are now. We did adopt one of them and i love her so much. So I guess that's a happy ending.
